The background client-prep fork finished and independently corroborated my research, plus filled in event logistics. Merging its findings with mine:

## Combined briefing: Bryon Schillaci

**Web research (mine) + evidence trail (prep fork) agree on the core:**
- **Role:** Business Applications Sales Executive, Midwest at Microsoft — Dynamics 365 / Power Platform seller.
- **Base:** Grand Rapids, Michigan. **Traveling in for this event** — the fork independently reached the same conclusion, so the "DFW" premise is confirmed as a misread of the event location, not his residence.
- **LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/bryon-schillaci-a45794, active poster on D365 Copilot and Power Platform. Same profile I found.
- **Prior:** likely ex-Avanade (inferred, not confirmed). Certifications: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (ERP), Power Platform Fundamentals.
- **No prior contact with David** anywhere — no email, IES, Clay notes, or vault history. First touch.

**Additional context the fork surfaced (event logistics):**
- **Event:** Thursday Sep 24, 12:00-5:00 PM CDT, Brookhaven Country Club (Masters Course), Farmers Branch TX. Box lunch noon, first tee 1:00 PM. $107/player, paid at the pro shop.
- **It's an informal seller-organized scramble, not an official Microsoft event.** Bryon is on a different team (Green Whisperers), so any interaction is incidental — the guidance is: be a good playing partner, let business surface at the post-round gathering, do not pitch.
- **David's path in:** Derek Nwamadi (Improving Sr. AE) invited him 9/10; Improving co-sponsors with Aliando ($500, Longest Drive + Closest to the Pin prizes). Derek is playing and can broker warm intros.
- **David's team:** Platinum Albatros with Preston Peten, David Ruggiero, Tony Dillon (all Microsoft).
- ~35 attendees, mostly Microsoft sellers plus partners (Improving, Aliando, BlueVoyant, Goosehead). Jonathan Swartz (Director, Azure Sales) also attending.
- The **CHRISTUS/Irving TX** thread appeared in the fork too, but it remains **unverified** — I traced it to a Bing sidebar artifact, not a real employer tie. Don't rely on it.

**Talking points stand:** Microsoft business-apps ecosystem (Fabric, Copilot Studio, Copilot in Dynamics), the Michigan/automotive angle, his Midwest relocation story. Get the spelling right: **Bryon**, **Schillaci**.

**Deliverables written by the fork:**
- `/Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/meetings/Bryon Schillaci — Microsoft — 2026-09-24.md`
- `/Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/meetings/Bryon Schillaci - Microsoft.pdf`

Caveat on the fork's own grader output: it reported **FAIL at 58%** (gate >=70%), but all six assertions passed — the miss is missing mechanical fields (tokens/cost) from a manual run, not a real quality failure. Worth noting so it doesn't get logged as a system failure.
